facts.claim: An assessment of Twenty Cents per share was levied upon the capital stock of the corporation at a board of directors meeting held on February 24, 1879.
facts.quote: an assessment (No. 3) of Twenty Cents per share was levied upon she capital stock of the corporation, payable immediately in U.S gold coitr, to the Secretary, at the office of the company, Room 29, 203 Bush street, Cosmopolitan Hotel, San Francisco, California.
